question: What subtasks did they participate in?

answer.free_form_answer: Answer with content missing: (Subscript 1: "We did not participate in subtask 5 (E-c)") Authors participated in EI-Reg, EI-Oc, V-Reg and V-Oc subtasks.
evidence: Our submissions ranked second (EI-Reg), second (EI-Oc), fourth (V-Reg) and fifth (V-Oc), demonstrating that the proposed method is accurate in automatically determining the intensity of emotions and sentiment of Spanish tweets. This paper will first focus on the datasets, the data generation procedure, and the techniques and tools used. Then we present the results in detail, after which we perform a small error analysis on the largest mistakes our model made. We conclude with some possible ideas for future work.

title: UG18 at SemEval-2018 Task 1: Generating Additional Training Data for Predicting Emotion Intensity in Spanish
answer_rationale: Text 1 and Text 3 both state that they participated in four Spanish subtasks and placed second (EI-Reg), second (EI-Oc), fourth (V-Reg), and fifth (V-Oc). These are the specific subtasks mentioned in the documents.
